reponse: Here's what the results show about the November Loomly fees. There's a conflict: a Zendesk ticket from Nov 17 claims management approved a full refund of all November fees to every Loomly seller [1], but the most recent confirmed sources say otherwise. Per Slack's #finance channel, Quillon approved a credit of the November payout fees on the 1,212 affected payouts only (≈ $3,940), applied to the December 1 invoice, with no cash refunds to individual sellers [2]. This is confirmed in an email to Hannah [3] and tracked in Jira task QPAY-2335 [4]. Company policy also states credits go on the customer's next invoice, and cash refunds are never issued to sellers [5].
